Found 8 items in registries @ui-shrushank:

Showing items 1-8 of 8:

- primary-button (registry:component) - The default call to action, solid fill with hover and focus states. [@ui-shrushank] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- ghost-button (registry:component) - A lower-emphasis outline button for secondary actions. [@ui-shrushank] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- toggle-switch (registry:component) - An accessible on/off switch built on a native button. [@ui-shrushank] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- text-field (registry:component) - A labeled text input with clear focus and placeholder states. [@ui-shrushank] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- badge (registry:component) - A small status pill with neutral, success, and warning tones. [@ui-shrushank] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- breadcrumbs (registry:component) - A simple breadcrumb trail with an aria-current page marker. [@ui-shrushank] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- commit-graph (registry:component) - A contribution heatmap paged by two-week sprints, drillable to the day. [@ui-shrushank] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- all (registry:component) - All 7 free components in one install. Premium items are available to Pro buyers from the private registry. [@ui-shrushank] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
